reasons.plan: Only a handful of cards support Adeline's go-wide attack plan (Divine Visitation, Inquisitorial Rosette, Worthy Knight, Makindi Stampede, Springjack Shepherd), while much of the deck is unrelated filler like Bargain, Alpha Myr, Dawn-Blessed Pennant, Tine Shrike and Darksteel Brute.
reasons.mana: Mono-white colours are dependable, but 45 lands (42 Plains plus Archaeological Dig, Cactus Preserve and Makindi Mesas) is far too many for a curve topping out mostly at 3, flooding the deck.
reasons.ramp: Real acceleration is limited to Commander's Sphere and Darksteel Ingot, plus a one-shot Golden Egg, Archaeological Dig and the narrow Foundry Inspector.
reasons.draw: There are many one-shot cantrips (Golden Egg, Tsabo's Web, Novice Inspector, Scroll of Avacyn, Implement of Improvement, Wrench, Combat Thresher), but the only repeatable sources are the symmetrical Loran and the narrow Harper Recruiter and Gate to the Afterlife.
reasons.interaction: Answers are few and clunky, namely Loran, Arbalest Elite, Molten-Tail Masticore, Tower of Calamities and the risky Worldslayer reset, with tappers and Cliffside Rescuer or Haystack for protection.

details.summary: A mono-white Adeline deck with a recognisable go-wide core, diluted by low-impact filler, minimal ramp and narrow removal. Its 45 lands will often flood it out.

details.summary: This is a mono-red deck with a loose artifact-sacrifice core that suits Pia and Kiran, but it is diluted by filler creatures, runs too many lands and has thin card flow. Its removal can handle creatures but nothing else.

reasons.plan: Prismari's storm for instants and sorceries has little to do with the roughly 31 artifacts, and many cards are filler that serve neither plan, such as Boggart Brute, Goblin Boarders, Coral Barrier, Cathar's Shield, Tsabo's Web and Tawnos's Weaponry.
reasons.fit: About a third of the deck is artifacts, with some payoffs like Pinnacle Emissary, Ravenous Robots, Foundry Inspector, Krang and Pia and Kiran Nalaar, but the commander doesn't support the theme and many of the artifacts are weak standalone cards.
reasons.mana: 36 lands split 17 Island and 17 Mountain, with Archaeological Dig, suit a curve concentrated at 2-4 for a two-colour deck, though Shrine of the Forsaken Gods adds little.
reasons.ramp: Only about four real rocks (Commander's Sphere, Darksteel Ingot, Luck Bobblehead, Bucknard's Everfull Purse) plus marginal help from Golden Egg, Magic Pot and Foundry Inspector, which is thin for a 7-mana commander.
reasons.draw: There are many small sources, including Brilliant Spectrum, Prophetic Bolt, Treasure Hunt, Krang, Tezzeret's Gatebreaker, Clues from Confirm Suspicions and Resonance Technician, and cantrip artifacts, with Teferi and Bloodfire Mentor as repeatable looters.
reasons.interaction: There are plenty of answers, including Jaya's Greeting, Thundering Rebuke, Deem Inferior, Frogify, the counterspells Vex, Neutralize and Confirm Suspicions, and the pingers Chainflinger and Wojek Embermage, but the only sweepers are the small Whipflare and the clunky Worldslayer.

details.summary: This is a playable Izzet deck with decent interaction and card flow, but its artifact theme is diluted by filler and has no real tie to Prismari's storm ability, and ramp is light for its commander.

reasons.plan: Koma's plan of landing a big trampler is diluted by many unrelated small cards such as Emerald Dragonfly, Darkwatch Elves, Lys Alana Huntmaster, Timberwatch Elf, Janjeet Sentry, Michelangelo and Wandering Troubadour, so well over a fifth of the deck serves nothing.
reasons.fit: Only a handful of cards are genuinely big threats (Phantom Wurm, Grappling Kraken, All-Seeing Arbiter, March of the World Ooze, Stonecoil Serpent, Feral Incarnation), and the curve peaks at 21 two-drops, so 'big creatures' is followed in name only.
reasons.mana: 37 lands, mostly basics split 18 Forest and 15 Island, reliably produce both colours, with only The Shire and Opal Palace as minor drags, though 37 is a little high for this low curve.
reasons.ramp: About six or seven real ramp pieces (Keeper of Progenitus, Runadi, Obsidian Obelisk, Roiling Regrowth, Growing Rites of Itlimoc, H.E.R.B.I.E., Thrasios), which is modest for a 7-mana commander.
reasons.draw: Draw is plentiful, with repeatable sources (Thrasios, Third Path Savant, Elrond, Anvil of Bogardan, Ant-Man) and one-shots (Riverwise Augur, Orysa, All-Seeing Arbiter, Geistwave, Escape Detection, Lammastide Weave), plus creature tutors like Shared Summons.
reasons.interaction: There are many answers, but they are mostly temporary bounce and tempo (Just the Wind, Geistwave, Murk Strider, Escape Detection, Grappling Kraken) plus a few counters (Counterlash, Preemptive Strike, Trickbind), with little hard removal (Lignify, Atraxa's Fall, Monstrous Emergence) and no board reset.

details.summary: A Simic deck with solid lands and good card flow, but it is cluttered with small, unfocused creatures and light on ramp and big threats, so it delivers only loosely on 'ramp into big creatures' around Koma.

reasons.plan: Nearly every creature flies and Kangee's attack pump is backed by anthems and attack boosts like Empyrean Eagle, Thunderclap Wyvern, Favorable Winds, Steel-Plume Marshal and Kangee's Lieutenant, with only a few loose cards such as Felidar Retreat and Remorseful Cleric.
reasons.fit: The request was a flyers deck, and the deck is built around flying creatures, flying anthems, flying payoffs like Tide Skimmer, Windreader Sphinx and Sephara, and flying cost reduction from Warden of Evos Isle.
reasons.mana: 36 lands with Command Tower and eight other dual-colour or utility lands give dependable white and blue, though five always-tapped duals (Coastal Tower, Meandering River, Sejiri Refuge, Temple of Enlightenment, Tranquil Cove) slow it somewhat.
reasons.ramp: About eight pieces (Arcane Signet, Talisman of Progress, Commander's Sphere, Sky Diamond, Hedron Archive, Wayfarer's Bauble, Pilgrim's Eye and Warden of Evos Isle) suit a curve that peaks at three mana.
reasons.draw: Well over eight sources, including the repeatable Windreader Sphinx, Tide Skimmer, Welcoming Vampire, Faerie Formation and Isperia alongside one-shots like Sphinx's Revelation, Mind Spiral and Inspiring Overseer.
reasons.interaction: Swords to Plowshares, Path to Exile, Banishing Light, Prayer of Binding, Counterspell, Absorb, Sinister Sabotage and Surge of Salvation give flexible answers and protection, and Cleansing Nova, Time Wipe and Aetherize can reset the board.

details.summary: This is a focused, well-built Kangee flyers deck with strong draw and interaction, sound ramp and a solid mana base, held back only slightly by a handful of tapped lands.
